models.name: Silero VAD CoreML (aufklarer/Silero-VAD-v6.2.1-CoreML)

models.name: Smart Turn v3.2 CoreML (aufklarer/Smart-Turn-v3.2-CoreML)

license: the model card metadata (license: bsd-2-clause) and the LICENSE file of the repository, a BSD 2-Clause notice of Daily for the upstream pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 weights (read on 2026-11-16)

models.name: Kokoro-82M CoreML (aufklarer/Kokoro-82M-CoreML)
notes: the text-to-speech model and its two grapheme-to-phoneme models, downloaded after the person presses Install and never bundled
license: the model card metadata (license: apache-2.0), read on 2026-11-15; base model hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, also apache-2.0 in its card

models.name: Kokoro English pronunciation dictionaries (us_gold, us_silver)
notes: downloaded with the model; the model card states Apache-2.0 for the dictionaries and gives no upstream source for their data

provenance is not stated upstream: the misaki project (https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki, Apache-2.0, LICENSE read on 2026-11-15) holds dictionaries of the same names, which is not proof that these are those

models.name: Pronunciation tables of speech-swift KokoroTTS (French, Portuguese, Hindi)
notes: bundled in the app with the KokoroTTS target of speech-swift, which offers no language but English
license: as stated by the comment of PronunciationDicts.swift in the pinned revision (ipa-dict, MIT); the upstream license file was not read

models.name: pinyin-to-ipa mapping (stefantaubert/pinyin-to-ipa)
